findings.title: Maintained alpha-Fe campaign bypasses B1 and dispatches twice under concurrency
findings.root_cause: A separate public submit implementation checks marker/attempt existence, then uses atomic replacement instead of exclusive reservation creation. It calls subprocess.run([bsub, run.lsf]) without the gate, execution authorization, backend restriction or input/evidence/POTCAR binding. Atomic replacement does not serialize competing submitters.
findings.reproduction: Create one temporary case/run.lsf only. Set module WORKDIR and CASES to the fixture. Replace subprocess.run with a fake returning distinct job IDs. Synchronize two threads immediately before the unchanged _write_json_atomic, after both have passed absence checks. Two concurrent real submit() calls reach fake bsub for the same case without any gate/authorization/bundle. This synchronization selects a possible race schedule; it does not replace reservation logic.

outcomes: FileNotFoundError: [WinError 2] 系统找不到指定的文件。: 'C:\\Users\\86177\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\b1b7-rerun-evidence\\legacy-submit-fixture\\case\\submission_attempt.json'

findings.impact: On a configured scheduler host this maintained entry can create duplicate expensive VASP jobs and bypass the B1 contract. One caller returns; the other raises FileNotFoundError deleting the shared attempt after both dispatches. P0 denotes demonstrated duplicate external-execution risk; no real job was submitted during the audit.
findings.origin: Pre-existing in main; B2 updated its INCAR check but left this entry operational. modules/convergence_workflow/README.md lists it and tests/test_alpha_fe_bulk_submission.py exercises it; it is not archived/dead.
findings.test_gap: B5 counts only the exact string bsub script.lsf and misses the list [bsub, run.lsf]. Legacy tests cover sequential markers and timeout recovery but no concurrent/execution-authorization boundary. Canonical NEB executor tests remain passing.
findings.recommended_repair_scope: Separately close or route this existing campaign submission entry through the established B1 boundary, preserving scientific settings. Add fake-command concurrent/no-authorization regressions across all maintained dispatch forms. Do not add another executor.

findings.title: Custodian raw MAGMOM lookup retains a divergent INCAR parser
findings.root_cause: Independent line/equals splitting misses semicolon-separated tags after the first setting.
findings.reproduction: NELM=60; MAGMOM = 3*2.0 returns raw_incar_value(path, MAGMOM)=None; vasp_result_gate.read_incar_values(path)[MAGMOM] returns 3*2.0.
findings.impact: Literal MAGMOM retention disagrees with the authoritative parser. Main INCAR loading uses pymatgen; no changed numerical spin values or accepted-science error was demonstrated. Nonblocking maintenance/format-preservation defect.
findings.recommended_repair_scope: Use the existing INCAR owner for raw tag lookup, preserve the optional-return API, and cover semicolon/literal retention.

findings.title: Calibration OUTCAR metadata retains historical completion booleans
findings.root_cause: The force/energy extractor independently accumulates ionic_converged/normal_completion and does not reset them for a newer incomplete run.
findings.reproduction: A synthetic completed converged force/energy block followed by vasp.6 and a new incomplete Iteration 1(1) yields ionic_converged=true and normal_completion=true here. The current utils_vasp.parse_outcar owner instead reports normal_completion=false and incomplete=true.
findings.impact: Direct extraction/calibration metadata can misrepresent current completion. Inspected accepted registry and active-learning/dual-model force-label paths also invoke validate_vasp_relaxation/final_scf_status, which fail closed. No accepted-result bypass is established; this is P2 rather than a claimed P1 false acceptance.
findings.origin: Pre-existing extractor; unchanged. Force/energy extraction is legitimate, but current-completion interpretation should delegate.
findings.recommended_repair_scope: Preserve extraction API and delegate completion/current-cycle interpretation to the VASP owner; cover appended/truncated output through direct label extraction.
